riderSteps.title: Find Your Ride in 3 Steps
riderSteps.description: Search, compare, and book. All in one place without requiring accounts up-front.
riderSteps.searchDesc: Enter from, to, and time to see all available rides. No more scrolling through chats or comments.
riderSteps.compareDesc: Sort by price, driver rating, pickup time and distance. Filter with your own rules.
riderSteps.bookDesc: Reserve a spot with verified UIUC email and pay on time. All drivers are verified.
